subject: Scoping & SOW timeline: Security compliance portal (pilot → standard)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <procurement@zenprocure.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: SOW and scoping estimate for compliance portal pilot

Hi Jordan,

Following up on our call earlier — we want a short SOW and firm timeline for a pilot of the compliance portal (Vanta) scoped to our engineering org (accounts, CI/CD, GCP projects). Target: 6-week pilot starting Jan 4.

Please send:
- A one-page SOW with milestones (discovery, deployment, evidence collection, verification)
- Estimated resource commitments from vendor and Redwood (hours / FTEs)
- List of required artifacts for our security team
- Any standard exclusions or assumptions you have

Marcus and Laura are the internal leads for engineering and security respectively — cc'd. We prefer a fixed-price pilot if possible. Attaching the baseline questionnaire we ran.

Thanks,
Kimberly
--
Kimberly Park
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Jordan Lee <procurement@zenprocure.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ellen Shaw <ellen@vanta.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOW and scoping estimate for compliance portal pilot

Hi Kim — thanks, will do. I looped in Ellen from Vanta to provide the SOW and a scoping worksheet. Expect an initial SOW draft by COB Monday (2026-11-02).

Quick note on pricing: Vanta typically offers a pilot bundle that includes 2 named support sessions and a one-time onboarding fee — I will try to get pricing options (fixed pilot vs time-and-materials) in the draft.

Jordan
ZenProcure (on behalf of Vanta)
From: Ellen Shaw <ellen@vanta.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <procurement@zenprocure.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:22:00Z
Subject: Vanta SOW draft + scoping worksheet

Kimberly — attached is a concise SOW PDF and a scoping worksheet (xlsx) for the pilot. Highlights:
- Pilot scope: up to 8 repos, 3 GCP projects, SSO + Okta integration, log collection from our primary cluster
- Timeline: 6 weeks (2w discovery, 2w implementation, 2w verification)
- Fixed pilot price: $28,000 (includes 2 onboarding sessions + 1 remediation review)
- Deliverables: onboarding notes, evidence bundle for SOC 2, and a 1-page post-pilot assessment

I also attached the security questionnaire answers we've prepared against your baseline. Please flag any items you want expanded.

Attachments: vanta-sow-draft-20261101.pdf, security-questionnaire-answers.xlsx

Regards,
Ellen Shaw
Enterprise Sales, Vanta
ellen@vanta.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ellen Shaw <ellen@vanta.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Vanta SOW draft + scoping worksheet

Thanks Ellen — quick engineering read: the scope looks reasonable but two asks before we sign:
1) Can we narrow “up to 8 repos” to an explicit list (we'll provide) so we avoid surprises?
2) We need assurance that the onboarding windows won't require dedicated infra changes during the Jan sprint freeze. Can we schedule verification sessions outside Jan 10–20?

Also, curious: do you provide a temporary test account for evidence ingestion to validate mappings before production? That would speed the pilot.

—Marcus
Director, Platform Engineering
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ellen Shaw <ellen@vanta.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Vanta SOW draft + scoping worksheet

Ellen — thanks for the draft. A few legal/compliance notes after a quick pass:
- Add a paragraph about data residency for logs pulled from GCP — we need confirmation logs remain in our project and Vanta only stores metadata necessary for evidence indexing.
- Add SLA language for the verification step (response within 48 hrs for triage tickets during pilot)
- Vanta's standard terms include an indemnity clause that our legal flagged; can we get a redline-friendly version of the terms?

I've attached a tracked-redline doc with our initial asks. If procurement wants to run fixed-price pilot, legal will need a short turn for redlines but can prioritize this.

Attachments: redlines-tracked-20261102.docx

Laura
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Shaw <ellen@vanta.com>, Jordan Lee <procurement@zenprocure.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Vanta SOW draft + scoping worksheet

Ellen / Jordan — thank you. Next steps from Redwood:
- Marcus will send the repo list and preferred Jan blackout dates by EOD tomorrow.
- Laura will upload the redline doc and legal comments into the Drive link and tag legal[at]redwood for review.
- I will confirm procurement's preferred contract cadence (1Pi or purchase order) — Jordan, please include the fixed-pilot quote and an hourly T&M fallback in the revised SOW.

Let's aim to have a redlined SOW and terms back to Vanta by 2026-11-10 so we can route approvals in November and keep the Jan start target.

Kimberly
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: redlines-tracked-20261102.docx
